Description: A four-week behavioural feature framework was developed using early interaction, activity and resource-engagement measures.
The framework was evaluated across OULAD and KDD Cup 2015 rather than relying on a single learning cohort.
Feature contribution analysis was incorporated to identify which early engagement behaviours most influenced predictions.
Bidirectional transfer experiments were conducted to examine whether predictive signal persisted across datasets.
Performance was examined across demographic subgroups rather than relying solely on aggregate model metrics.
